name: stremio-addon-catalogos
description: Addon de Stremio con catálogos de películas y series: Tendencias, Populares, Top Valoradas, por plataforma de streaming (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Max, Apple TV+, Paramount+, Star+, Crunchyroll) y por estudio (Marvel, Pixar, A24, Ghibli...). TMDB + TVMaze + OMDB + Watchmode.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/prerender-catalogs.mjs && node scripts/build-web.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.test: node --test test/smoke.test.js test/worker.test.js test/prerender.test.js test/api.test.js test/configurePage.test.js test/tmdb.test.js test/streams.test.js test/catalogs.test.js test/providers.test.js test/debrid.test.js test/streamFilters.test.js test/badges.test.js test/web.test.js test/watch.test.js test/watchUi.test.js

author: Comunidad Stremio
